---
title: "L: Antineoplastic and immunomodulating agents"
description: "ATC group L for modellers: toxicity sets the dose, tumour size feeds time-to-event, and target-mediated disposition makes antibodies nonlinear at low dose."
date: "2026-02-08"
---

Agents used to kill malignant cells and to push the immune system either way, from cytotoxics through targeted small molecules to antibodies and cell products.
The endpoint that decides the programme, survival, reads out late and is linked to exposure only through intermediates such as tumour size [@bender2015pkpd].

On 27 August 1942 a Yale team under Louis Goodman and Alfred Gilman gave intravenous nitrogen mustard, a chemical warfare agent, to a factory worker with lymphosarcoma.
Ten daily doses left no tumour on biopsy, though it returned by day 49 [@christakisBirthChemotherapyYale2011].

| Level 2 code | Description |
| ---: | :--- |
| L01 | Antineoplastic agents |
| L02 | Endocrine therapy |
| L03 | Immunostimulants |
| L04 | Immunosuppressants |

## Modelling notes

**Toxicity sets the dose, not efficacy (L01).**
Dose-limiting toxicity is a binary readout in a short early window [@letourneau2009dose; @yin2024handling].
For cytotoxics, neutropenia is the continuous alternative, captured by semi-mechanistic myelosuppression models with a proliferating compartment, maturation transit compartments and a feedback term [@friberg2002myelo; @camaradesouza2018transit].

**Efficacy is modelled in two steps (L01).**
A longitudinal tumour size model (RECIST sum of diameters) balances drug-driven shrinkage against regrowth [@ribba2014review; @stein2008tumor]; quantities derived from it feed a [time-to-event](/docs/modeling/tte/) analysis of survival [@claret2014tgimetrics; @bruno2014evaluation].
That is what lets early imaging inform an endpoint reading out much later [@claret2009phase3os; @chan2021tgios].

**Antibodies are nonlinear where it matters (L01).**
Target-mediated drug disposition makes binding itself an elimination pathway that saturates [@mager2001tmdd; @dua2015tmddtutorial], so a model fitted only to the top of the dose range will mislead at the bottom [@gibiansky2008tmddapprox].
Antibody-drug conjugates add conjugate, total antibody and payload as separate analytes [@li2020adcquant; @khan2025adcbioanalysis].

**Cell therapies replace PK with cellular kinetics (L01).**
A living product expands, contracts and persists [@liu2021carkinetics; @stein2019tisacell], and the administered dose is a weak predictor of the exposure that follows [@he2022cartdosing].

**Mechanistic extrapolation.**
PBPK is routine for kinase inhibitors, predicting CYP3A and gastric-pH interactions that reach labels; QSP extrapolates immuno-oncology dosing, notably CD3 bispecific T-cell engagers, from preclinical data [@yoshidaImpactPhysiologicallyBased2017; @bettsTranslationalQuantitativeSystems2019].

**E-R**
Exposure-response for targeted agents is drug-specific, not class-wide: no efficacy relationship was detectable across the osimertinib dose range [@brown2017osimertinib], while trough concentrations separated progression-free survival for crizotinib and alectinib [@groenland2021alk].

**Covariates carrying dosing guidance (L01).**
DPYD for fluoropyrimidines, TPMT and NUDT15 for thiopurines, UGT1A1 for irinotecan, CYP2D6 for tamoxifen [@kicken2025precision; @chatelut2018smki].

## CAR T cell therapy

![](https://pub.mdpi-res.com/pharmaceutics/pharmaceutics-14-01630/article_deploy/html/images/pharmaceutics-14-01630-g001.png?1659607210)

Emily Whitehead, the first child treated with CD19-directed CAR T cells for refractory acute lymphoblastic leukaemia, entered a durable complete remission [@grupp2013carall].
